decisions.reason: The margin analysis still has its own page in 2024, which signals results at or near aspiration, so management keeps it as a core offering while it prunes the rest of the portfolio.

The electricity tariff calculator went from its own page to a mere mention, a sign of falling short of aspiration, but it likely shares its data and technology with the remaining products, so the medium firm's slack allows carrying it for another year rather than dropping it.

The area definition tool has also slipped to a mention, which suggests weak standalone results, but it probably serves as a supporting component for the location-based products and costs little to keep, so it stays while problemistic search continues.
